$Comment: The second rung of the Seasons of Orbis ladder: a keepsake kept from four different seasons.
It picks exactly what the first rung picks (every Seasons achievement tagged season_keepsake, any
year's copy standing for its keepsake, counted by season) and asks for more of them: Needs is how
many seasons it takes. Until a server runs that many seasons it waits, and it is earned the moment
the last one is kept. The description's number comes from TextArgs, so keep it equal to Needs.
Rewards: the festival tokens and the Festival Favor are Claims, waiting on the achievements page
until the player collects them. A title is the one thing an achievement pays the moment it is earned.
One Claim row is MMO Skill Tree's Mmo_Boost_Token, half again as much XP in every skill for an
hour, which the player starts when it suits them; its own Requires, the hytale:mod_installed gate,
leaves that row out on a server without that mod, unpaid and unshown. Add any new Claim row at the end.
